# `WorldApi::get_cell_structures_on_layer`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-engine-side">engine-side</span> <span class="sdk-kind">method</span>

Source: **World API** (`src/plugins/api/world_api.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Returns structures that occupy one cell through a particular layer.

## Signature

```rust
fn get_cell_structures_on_layer (& self , cell : UVec2 , layer : LayerKind ,) -> Result < Vec < StructureInfo > , WorldApiError >
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |

| `cell` | UVec2 | `cell` argument passed as `UVec2`. |
| `layer` | [`LayerKind`](../structures/layerkind.md) | `layer` argument passed as `LayerKind`. |

## Return Value

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-structures-on-layer.md`](../../examples/methods/worldapi-get-cell-structures-on-layer.md)_

```rust
let structures = world.get_cell_structures_on_layer(
    UVec2::new(24, 18),
    LayerKind::new("flux.core.layer.appearance"),
)?;
assert!(structures.iter().all(|structure| !structure.occupied_cells.is_empty()));
```
